title: TimestepperTestCases.jl: Test cases and analysis for a conservative Runge–Kutta framework for nonlinear free-surface ocean models
description: Oceananigans simulation setups, buoyancy-variance diagnostics of numerical mixing, and the time-discretization theory (TimestepperTheory) accompanying the manuscript "A conservative Runge–Kutta framework for nonlinear free-surface ocean models". The repository contains the internal-tide, re-entrant channel and quarter-degree global ocean configurations, and the scripts that reproduce every manuscript figure from the simulation outputs archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24315107.
